509:t_000:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「We've confirmed an approaching force believed to be $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

509:t_000:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So they are attacking us... Launch the mobile forces.」

509:t_001:0.en:
$$シン$$
「Will you be all right on your own, $$セツコ$$?」

509:t_001:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Thank you, $$シン$$. But there's no need to worry.」

509:t_001:2.en:
$n
($$セツコ$$ senses something... Is $$バルビエル$$ coming...?)

509:t_001:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't overthink it either, $n. Our enemy is $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

509:t_001:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Maybe I've thought about so many things that my brain has finally stopped working.」

509:t_001:6.en:
$$ファ$$
「Your brain stopped working, $$カミーユ$$?」

509:t_001:8.en:
$$フォウ$$
「That's not a bad thing. Sometimes feeling is more important than thinking.」

509:t_001:9.en:
$n
「My dad used to say something like that too. ...Apparently he borrowed it from somewhere.」

509:t_001:10.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Then let's just be ourselves and take down everyone who comes at us!」

509:t_001:11.en:
$$パーラ$$
「In your case, $$ガロード$$, I think you could use your head a little more.」

509:t_001:12.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「You and $$キラ$$ could use your heads more too, $$シン$$.」

509:t_001:15.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「In your case, $$キラ$$, maybe it's more accurate to say we can't tell what you're thinking because you barely show it on your face.」

509:t_001:19.en:
$$デュオ$$
「The quiet types and our clueless Prince Freedom are pretty similar when it comes to doing their own thing.」

509:t_001:20.en:
$$シン$$
「Then, since I look after $$キラ$$, do I get to join the Short Straw Alliance too?」

509:t_001:21.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「...You need to see yourself a little more objectively, $$シン$$.」

509:t_001:22.en:
$$五飛$$
「You must learn that you cannot convince others with your own reasoning alone.」

509:t_001:25.en:
$$トロワ$$
「$$五飛$$ is probably speaking from his own experience too.」

509:t_001:27.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「He seems to have pressed his own self-destruct button.」
